bullets: Dowman Jones opened the season on top with 86 points, the highest score of the gameweek, playing Bench Boost in week one.
Eight of the 23 teams spent Bench Boost immediately, and six of them finished in the top seven because of it.
Haaland was the runaway captain pick with 13 of 23 armbands and returned just 2 points, a costly opening call for most of the league.
The highest scoring player owned in this league was Mamadou Sangaré of Brentford with 14 points, held by only 4 managers.
Rash Decisions had the roughest opener at 19 points, the only team under 30.
Scoring was low and tightly bunched: only two teams cleared 80 and the median score was 53.
No movement arrows and no transfers this week. GW1 was the first standings snapshot and everyone was still on their original squad.
